Suggested role handoff

SME → PM → Design → Technical → Team review

Use the Copilot app

  1. Choose the named agent or invoke its skill in chat.
  2. Attach your shared session-context path.
  3. Copy a source prompt, review placeholders and path warnings, then send it yourself.
  4. Review the draft and hand the saved artifact to the next role.

This guide does not send prompts, create issues, deploy, publish or approve work.

Stuck or missing a component?

Check available slash commands, repository customizations and enabled plugins. A VS Code extension does not automatically configure this app.

Keep a Markdown backlog if GitHub writes are unavailable. Record missing evidence as Unknown and name its owner. Optional Figma and cloud actions require separate setup and consent.
